evidence: Modifies RPC argument handling and deprecation checks in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp for non-wallet RPCs such as createrawtransaction and createpsbt.
rationale: Follows standard RPC deprecation discipline for obsolete BIP 125 parameters across raw transaction RPCs. Deprecating arguments without immediately removing them ensures compatibility for external callers, though addressing redundant parameter clutter is reasonably deferrable.
